final_response.answer: You still need to complete the full set of required courses for the Mathematics major with the Applied Discrete Mathematics option: Calculus I (MATH 1225) and II (MATH 1226), Discovering Mathematics I & II (MATH 1004, 1044), Linear Algebra I (MATH 2114) and Linear Algebra II (MATH 4144), Multivariable Calculus (MATH 2204), Differential Equations (MATH 2214), Introduction to Proofs (MATH 3034), Modern Algebra (MATH 3124), Calculus of Several Variables (MATH 3214), Applied Combinatorics and Graph Theory (MATH 3134), Probability/Statistics for Engineers (STAT 4705), Advanced Calculus (MATH 3224), Data Structures and Algorithms (CS 3114), Software Design and Data Structures (CS 2114), Introduction to Computer Organization (CS 2505), Data and Algorithm Analysis (or Formal Languages/Computation) (CS 4104), plus the elective‑option courses you choose such as Abstract Algebra (MATH 4124), Number Theory (MATH 4134), Linear Algebra II (MATH 4144), Cryptography (MATH 4175/4176), Graph Theory 1 (MATH 5454), or Combinatorics 1 (MATH 5464).
